info.title: Secret Santa API
info.description: API for organizing Secret Santa gift exchanges

post.summary: Create an event (public). Emails the organizer their personal link.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (5/hour per IP, 3/hour per organizer email)

get.summary: Events the person participates in (any status), with their own participant, soonest exchange date first

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

get.summary: Event details with participant names and statuses (participant). The first view records firstOpenedAt.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

404.description: Unknown event, or the person is not a participant

patch.summary: Edit details and dates (organizer). Only the given fields change.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: The person is a participant but not the organizer

404.description: Unknown event, or the person is not a participant

delete.summary: Delete the event and all its data (organizer)

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: The person is a participant but not the organizer

404.description: Unknown event, or the person is not a participant

post.summary: Email an additional personal link if the email is known. Always 202.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (5/hour per IP, 3/hour per email)

get.summary: The person identified by the magic token

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

get.summary: List participants (participant). Everyone sees names and statuses; the organizer also sees emails, invitation state, caretakers and wishlist flags.

200.description: ParticipantSummary items, or OrganizerParticipant items for the organizer

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

404.description: Unknown event, or the person is not a participant

post.summary: Add a participant silently, no email (organizer, open events). At most 50 participants.

400.description: Invalid input, or the caretaker is not a non-managed participant of this event

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: The person is a participant but not the organizer

404.description: Unknown event, or the person is not a participant

409.description: The event is drawn or finished, the person is already a participant, or the event has 50 participants

delete.summary: Remove a participant with their wishlists and exclusions (organizer, open events)

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: The person is a participant but not the organizer

404.description: Unknown event or participant, or the person is not a participant

409.description: The event is drawn or finished, the participant is the organizer, or a caretaker who still has managed participants

post.summary: Send or resend the invitation to one participant with a new personal link (organizer, open events)

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: The person is a participant but not the organizer

404.description: Unknown event or participant, or the person is not a participant

409.description: The event is drawn or finished

422.description: The participant is a managed participant, who never receives emails

post.summary: Send invitations to every non-managed participant not invited yet (organizer, open events). Never re-sends.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: The person is a participant but not the organizer

404.description: Unknown event, or the person is not a participant

409.description: The event is drawn or finished

post.summary: Decline: leave the draw (open events). A caretaker may act for a managed participant with X-Acting-As.

parameters.name: X-Acting-As
parameters.description: Participant id of a managed participant to act as; only their caretaker may

200.description: The participant with the new status

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: X-Acting-As names a participant the caller is not the caretaker of

404.description: Unknown event, or the person is not a participant

409.description: The event is drawn or finished, or the organizer tries to decline

post.summary: Rejoin: undo a decline (open events). A caretaker may act for a managed participant with X-Acting-As.

parameters.name: X-Acting-As
parameters.description: Participant id of a managed participant to act as; only their caretaker may

200.description: The participant with the new status

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: X-Acting-As names a participant the caller is not the caretaker of

404.description: Unknown event, or the person is not a participant

409.description: The event is drawn or finished

get.summary: List exclusion pairs (organizer): the organizer's pairs and the built-in caretaker / managed participant pairs (builtIn: true), ordered by participant ids

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: The person is a participant but not the organizer

404.description: Unknown event, or the person is not a participant

post.summary: Exclude two participants from drawing each other, in either order (organizer, open events). Stored with participantAId < participantBId.

400.description: Invalid input, the same participant twice, or not both participants of this event

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: The person is a participant but not the organizer

404.description: Unknown event, or the person is not a participant

409.description: The event is drawn or finished, the pair is already excluded, or it is a caretaker and their managed participant (always excluded)

delete.summary: Remove an exclusion pair, ids in either order (organizer, open events)

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: The person is a participant but not the organizer

404.description: Unknown event or exclusion, or the person is not a participant

409.description: The event is drawn or finished, or the pair is a built-in caretaker pair

get.summary: Wishlists the participant may read: their own wishlist (first), once drawn their recipient's own wishlist, and every child wishlist of the event. Items of child wishlists carry claim info (claimedByMe, claimedBy), except on the caller's own children's wishlists. A caretaker may act for a managed participant with X-Acting-As.

parameters.name: X-Acting-As
parameters.description: Participant id of a managed participant to act as; only their caretaker may

200.description: Own wishlist first, then the recipient's own wishlist (once drawn), then child wishlists oldest first

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: X-Acting-As names a participant the caller is not the caretaker of

404.description: Unknown event, or the person is not a participant

post.summary: Create the participant's own wishlist (at most one) or a child wishlist (open or drawn events). A caretaker may act for a managed participant with X-Acting-As.

parameters.name: X-Acting-As
parameters.description: Participant id of a managed participant to act as; only their caretaker may

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: X-Acting-As names a participant the caller is not the caretaker of

404.description: Unknown event, or the person is not a participant

409.description: The event is finished, the participant already has their own wishlist, or already has 10 child wishlists

patch.summary: Update a wishlist (owner, open or drawn events). Given items replace the list in order: items passed with their id keep it (and any claim), items without an id are new, items left out are removed. A caretaker may act for a managed participant with X-Acting-As.

parameters.name: X-Acting-As
parameters.description: Participant id of a managed participant to act as; only their caretaker may

400.description: Invalid input, an item id not on this wishlist, or a child name for an own wishlist

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: A child wishlist of another participant, or X-Acting-As names a participant the caller is not the caretaker of

404.description: Unknown event or wishlist, someone else's own wishlist, or the person is not a participant

delete.summary: Delete a wishlist with its items (owner, open or drawn events). A caretaker may act for a managed participant with X-Acting-As.

parameters.name: X-Acting-As
parameters.description: Participant id of a managed participant to act as; only their caretaker may

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: A child wishlist of another participant, or X-Acting-As names a participant the caller is not the caretaker of

404.description: Unknown event or wishlist, someone else's own wishlist, or the person is not a participant

put.summary: Claim an item of a child wishlist ("I'll buy this"), open or drawn events. Not by the child's parent: the wishlist owner or their caretaker, also when acting via X-Acting-As. Repeating one's own claim changes nothing. A caretaker may claim for a managed participant with X-Acting-As.

parameters.name: X-Acting-As
parameters.description: Participant id of a managed participant to act as; only their caretaker may

200.description: Claimed (or already claimed by the participant)

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: The caller is the child's parent, or X-Acting-As names a participant the caller is not the caretaker of

404.description: Unknown event or item, an item not on a child wishlist of this event, or the person is not a participant

409.description: The item is claimed by someone else, or the event is finished

delete.summary: Release one's own claim on a child wishlist item (the claimer, open or drawn events). Releasing an unclaimed item changes nothing. A caretaker may act for a managed participant with X-Acting-As.

parameters.name: X-Acting-As
parameters.description: Participant id of a managed participant to act as; only their caretaker may

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: The item is claimed by someone else, the caller is the child's parent, or X-Acting-As names a participant the caller is not the caretaker of

404.description: Unknown event or item, an item not on a child wishlist of this event, or the person is not a participant

get.summary: My claims: the participant's shopping list of claimed child wishlist items. A caretaker may act for a managed participant with X-Acting-As.

parameters.name: X-Acting-As
parameters.description: Participant id of a managed participant to act as; only their caretaker may

200.description: By child wishlist (oldest first), items in the owner's order

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: X-Acting-As names a participant the caller is not the caretaker of

404.description: Unknown event, or the person is not a participant

post.summary: Run the draw (open → drawn) or redo it (drawn, before the exchange date), replacing every assignment (organizer). Draws all non-declined participants, respecting exclusions and the built-in caretaker / managed participant pairs, and queues a draw-result email per drawn participant (a managed participant's goes to their caretaker). The response never contains assignments.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: The person is a participant but not the organizer

404.description: Unknown event, or the person is not a participant

409.description: The event is finished, or a redo on or after the exchange date

422.description: Fewer than 3 non-declined participants, a non-managed participant not invited yet, or exclusions make the draw impossible

get.summary: The participant's own assignment: their recipient and the recipient's own wishlist. Never anyone else's, also not for the organizer. A caretaker may act for a managed participant with X-Acting-As.

parameters.name: X-Acting-As
parameters.description: Participant id of a managed participant to act as; only their caretaker may

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked magic token

403.description: X-Acting-As names someone the caller is not the caretaker of

404.description: Unknown event, the person is not a participant, or no assignment (not drawn yet, or declined before the draw)

budgetAmount.description: Minor units, e.g. 15000 = 150.00 PLN; requires budgetCurrency

exchangeOn.description: Not in the past in the event timezone

EventUpdate.description: Partial update: absent fields are unchanged; null or blank text clears description/rules; budgetAmount and budgetCurrency are set or cleared (null) together

exchangeOn.description: Not in the past in the (new) event timezone

MyParticipant.description: The caller's own participant in the event

managedParticipants.description: The caller's managed participants, whom they can act as with X-Acting-As

NewParticipant.description: Exactly one of email (a participant with a person) or managedByParticipantId (a managed participant)

managedByParticipantId.description: Caretaker: a non-managed participant of the same event

firstOpenedAt.description: First authenticated GET of the event

wishlistFilled.description: The participant's own wishlist has items or notes

participantAId.description: The lower of the two participant ids

participantBId.description: The higher of the two participant ids

builtIn.description: A caretaker and their managed participant: always excluded, cannot be added or removed

claimedByMe.description: Only on child wishlists, never for the child's parent: whether the participant holds the claim

claimedBy.description: Only on child wishlists, never for the child's parent: the claimer's name; null = unclaimed

participantId.description: The owner: the participant, or the parent of the child

childName.description: Absent or null = the participant's own wishlist

id.description: An item of this wishlist to keep; omit for a new item

WishlistUpdate.description: Partial update: at least one field; absent fields stay unchanged

parentName.description: The child's parent: the owner of the child wishlist

participantCount.description: How many participants were drawn and emailed

wishlist.description: The recipient's own wishlist; null if they have none
